in_arabic.name: سابقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: سابقة تعني الابتعاد و السبق في الخيرات و الفضائل، و هي من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و هي مشتقة من الفعل سبق، و تحمل معنى الإسراع في فعل الخير و التنافس في الأعمال الصالحة.

in_urdu.name: سابقہ
in_urdu.meaning: اچھی باتوں میں سبقت لینے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: سابقہ کا مطلب ہے کہ جو شخص اچھی باتوں میں سبقت لیتا ہے، اور یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس میں 'سابق' کا مطلب ہے 'سبقت لینے والا' یا 'پہلے کرنے والا'، اور یہ اسلامی تقویم میں بھی اہم ہے.

in_hindi.name: साबिका
in_hindi.meaning: अच्छे कार्यों में आगे रहने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: साबिका नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति अच्छे कार्यों में आगे रहता है, और यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'पूर्ववर्ती' या 'अग्रणी', और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है.

in_english.name: Sabiqa
in_english.meaning: One who precedes or leads in good deeds

In Islamic tradition, Sabiqa refers to one who leads or precedes others in good deeds, charitable actions, and righteous endeavors. This name is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and moral connotations, symbolizing a person of initiative, piety, and compassion.

The term Sabiqa is used to refer to the actions and events that began before the creation of the universe, which have been willed and decreed by Allah and are considered part of His perfect plan.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the term Sabiqa holds deep meaning and significance for Muslims as a reminder of Allah's complete and perfect control over all things, and the importance of submitting to His will and trusting in His wisdom and mercy. The belief in Allah's Sabiqa, His earlier decrees and actions, can provide comfort and reassurance to Muslims during times of hardship, uncertainty, or anxiety, as they trust that Allah has already decreed what is best for them.
